definitions.gloss: gradually; little by little; step by step
definitions.explanation: Indicates a gradual change or progression over time. Often used with verbs describing change of state.

examples.japanese: {段々|だんだん}と{暖|あたた}かくなってきた。
{日本語|にほんご}が{段々|だんだん}と{上手|じょうず}になっている。
examples.english: Your Japanese is getting better little by little.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{段々|だんだん}と{暗|くら}くなって、やがて{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The sky gradually grew darker, and before long it started to rain.

notes:
{段々|だんだん}と expresses gradual change over time. The particle と is often omitted in casual speech, giving {段々|だんだん} alone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜てくる: to gradually come to ~ (approaching the present)
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜ていく: to gradually go on to ~ (moving away from the present)
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜なる: to gradually become ~

EXAMPLE PATTERN:
{段々|だんだん}と{分|わ}かってきた (I gradually came to understand).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: gradually (more formal, written style)
- {次第|しだい}に: gradually (emphasizes sequential progression)
- {少|すこ}しずつ: little by little (focuses on small increments)
- {段々|だんだん} is the most common and natural in everyday conversation
